name: compute per-frame top-k frequency-bin peaks from the magnitudes
definition: for each frame, rank magnitude bins and write the top-k bins for that frame in descending magnitude order into a CSV keyed by frame.
failure_mode: incorrect ordering or depth (top bin not first) fails the accuracy check

name: convert a native chess network representation to a pytorch state dict
definition: parse a network file of a chess cnn in its original compressed format into pytorch-weight form
failure_mode: a misordering of layers or scaling mismatch makes load or inference fail
